summary: Frontend-only tests for (1) Offer Expiry Timer on /account?tab=offers and (2) Wallet Rewards 'View All' link on /account?tab=wallet. Both features work correctly end-to-end at 1920px and 390px.

offer_timer.coupon-timer-<code>: No coupons currently have valid_until in seeded data (coupons array shows AZO50/SAVE100/MONSOON20 without valid_until) - component code supports it correctly via OfferTimer in CouponRow

test_results.urgent_style_<24h: Not triggered in current data (earliest offer ends in 19d). Code path verified: urgent=true applies rose/pulse classes (bg-rose-500 text-white + animate-pulse).

critical_code_review_comments: CustomerExtras.jsx OfferTimer uses setInterval(1000) per timer. Multiple offers each spin an independent interval; consider lifting a single global `now` state to parent (OffersView) to reduce setState churn when there are many cards.
endMs regex handles YYYY-MM-DD but assumes local timezone. For UTC-stored end_date, consider appending 'Z' or server-aligning timezone to avoid off-by-one-day drift at midnight.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded offers (Monsoon 20%, First Booking, Diwali, 50% OFF, Deep Cleaning ₹100, Monsoon Special, Summer Special-Ended) and 2 scratch cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offer timer + Wallet View All rewards link both verified. No urgent-style (<24h) offer in current seed; if testing that path, create an offer with end_date within next 24h to see rose/pulse styling. Coupons currently lack valid_until in seed - code supports coupon-timer-<code> but seed data would need updating to visually exercise it.
